[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. [url="https://Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios"]Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios[/url].


[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Credentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Battle Royale, and Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get involved in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season the Top 3 will have ONE of their emotes added to the game to spawn in marbles for those who use the emote.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url="https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream"]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and may the force be with your marbles!
-Pixel by Pixel Studios[/p]

---------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.


[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Credentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Battle Royale, and Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get involved in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season the Top 3 will have ONE of their emotes added to the game to spawn in marbles for those who use the emote.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and may the force be with your marbles!
-Pixel by Pixel Studios

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.


[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Credentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Battle Royale, and Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get involved in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season the Top 3 will have ONE of their emotes added to the game to spawn in marbles for those who use the emote.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and may the force be with your marbles!
-Pixel by Pixel Studios

[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.


[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Credentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Battle Royale, and Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get involved in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season the Top 3 will have ONE of their emotes added to the game to spawn in marbles for those who use the emote.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and may the force be with your marbles!
-Pixel by Pixel Studios

[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Credentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get involved in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.

[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Credentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in picked Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Royale or our newest mode Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get involved in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Twitch Emotes?[/b]
Our game includes the functionality of certain emotes on Twitch.tv that will load specific skins into the game for the viewer who uses them. Its a fun little community thing we do.
Here is a list of Streamers that will have emotes in the game for Season 36:
[b][list][*]PixelbyPixelStudios
[*]MSLARacing (Enderzworld)
[*]Spooo
[*]baXcast
[*]TheTonyBlacks
[*]SiNiSTeRPLaNZ
[*]Kibble42
[*]Dueblix
[*]MsDopeSauce
[/list][/b]

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season the Top 3 will have ONE of their emotes added to the game to spawn in marbles for those who use the emote.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and may the force be with your marbles!
-Pixel by Pixel Studios

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991916/dbd0bda7f464fdb7dbb68f6224f5a07dfe5c93ed.png[/img]
---------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.

[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Credentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in picked Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Royale or our newest mode Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get involved in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Twitch Emotes?[/b]
Our game includes the functionality of certain emotes on Twitch.tv that will load specific skins into the game for the viewer who uses them. Its a fun little community thing we do.
Here is a list of Streamers that will have emotes in the game for Season 33:
[b][list][*]PixelbyPixelStudios
[*]MSLARacing (Enderzworld)
[*]Spooo
[*]IguanaDefuzil
[*]TheTonyBlacks
[*]SinisterPlanz
[*]Kibble42
[*]iBlackish_
[/list][/b]

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season we take the top 10 Streamers and host a fun little collection of events and the streamer who earns the most points during the last day of the season events will earn their emote in the game for the next 2 seasons. Their emote will load their own custom marble into the race for that time.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and may your marbles roll swiftly!
-Pixel by Pixel Studios

[b]Say HELLO to Season 28!!![/b]

The Season 28 update is rolling out to steam as we speak!

There is a lot happening this Season, so be sure to pay attention to Discord and Twitter!

If you are not seeing the update please try shutting down Steam and restarting it. It should process the update then!

We hope to have the mobile app updates for Android (GooglePlay) and the Apple iOS available shortly.

Patch notes will be posted soon. Season 28 will be from November 3rd, 2021 to November 28th, 2021!

Enjoy this Spooky Season!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991916/f86a3ab7a3fa9a9877225c0309c3a7431ed37958.png[/img]
---------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.

[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Crendentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in picked Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Royale or our newest mode Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get invovled in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Twitch Emotes?[/b]
Our game includes the functionality of certain emotes on Twitch.tv that will load specific skins into the game for the viewer who uses them. Its a fun little community thing we do.
Here is a list of Streamers that will have emotes in the game for Season 24:
[b][list][*]PixelbyPixelStudios
[*]Enderzworld
[*]Spooo
[*]IguanaDefuzil
[*]Not_Ferrari
[*]SkankinMonkee
[*]TheTonyBlacks
[*]SinisterPlanz
[/list][/b]
[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season we take the top 10 Streamers and host a fun little collection of events and the streamer who earns the most points during the last day of the season events will earn their emote in the game for the next 2 seasons. Their emote will load their own custom marble into the race for that time.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and may your marbles roll swiftly!
-Pixel by Pixel Studios

notes.title: MSLA Event - Season 4 Begins - The Marble 500
notes.content:
Off season testing is almost done as the Marbles and the Teams fine tune their equipment to make sure they bring their best load-outs to the track...

We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season we take the top 10 Streamers and host a fun little collection of events and the streamer who earns the most points during the last day of the season events will earn their emote in the game for the next 2 seasons. Their emote will load their own custom marble into the race for that time.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and may your marbles roll swiftly!
-Pixel by Pixel Studios

[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.

[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Crendentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in picked Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Royale or our newest mode Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get invovled in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Twitch Emotes?[/b]
Our game includes the functionality of certain emotes on Twitch.tv that will load specific skins into the game for the viewer who uses them. Its a fun little community thing we do.
Here is a list of Streamers that will have emotes in the game for Season 21:

[*]Spooo
[*]LTDigilusion
[*]Kibble42
[*]Vibblez
[*]TheTonyBlacks
[*]AlmostYeti
[*]MOS_Pachinko[/list][/b]
[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. [b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.

[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Crendentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in picked Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Royale or our newest mode Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get invovled in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Twitch Emotes?[/b]
Our game includes the functionality of certain emotes on Twitch.tv that will load specific skins into the game for the viewer who uses them. Its a fun little community thing we do.
Here is a list of Streamers that will have emotes in the game for Season 21:
[b][list][*]PixelbyPixelStudios
[*]Enderzworld
[*]Spooo
[*]StandardDamage
[*]LTDigilusion
[*]Headsnap_TV
[*]Kibble42
[*]AudeoVisual
[*]Vibblez
[*]MOS_Pachinko[/list][/b]

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season we take the top 10 Streamers and host a fun little collection of events and the streamer who earns the most points during the last day of the season events will earn their emote in the game for the next 2 seasons. Their emote will load their own custom marble into the race for that time.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and may your marbles roll swiftly!
-Pixel by Pixel Studios

notes.title: PbP Coin Purchasing Error (Jan 22nd 2021)
notes.content:
There are 2 known purchase issues with our system at the moment regarding our APPs (Google and Apple). We want to extend awareness for this issue as we still have yet to be able to fix it. 

[b]1.[/b] Purchases through Google and Apple have a chance to go into a pending state defined by the platform, when this occurs our system is not notified of this state therefor once the purchase is verified by the platform you do not get the coins you purchased. 

Solution - Reach out to me through Discord with your Google or Apple receipt and I will be sure to correct this issue and ensure you get your purchase. 

[b]2.[/b] Some users are informed on Google and Apple that they cannot purchase a coin pack because they already own it.

Solution - You can still conduct purchases on steam as this system operates differently. 

Pixel by Pixel Studios Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios]https://discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios[/url]

We want to thank everyone for their patience with us trying to solve these issues. Please if you ever see anyone having issues like the above send them to us as we do not want these types of issues to go unhanded. 

Thank you. 
Pixel By Pixel Studios

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991916/8258d132a8abce54bce07cedbbffa6fb2fe9dd42.png[/img]

---------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.

[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Crendentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in picked Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Royale or our newest mode Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get invovled in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season we take the top 10 Streamers and host a fun little collection of events and the streamer who earns the most points during the last day of the season events will earn their emote in the game for the next 2 seasons. Their emote will load their own custom marble into the race for that time.

[b]- Twitch Emotes?[/b]
Our game includes the functionality of certain emotes on Twitch.tv that will load specific skins into the game for the viewer who uses them. Its a fun little community thing we do.
Here is a list of Streamers that will have emotes in the game for Season 19:
[b][list][*]PixelbyPixelStudios
[*]Enderzworld
[*]Spooo
[*]StandardDamage
[*]LTDigilusion
[*]HeadsnapTV
[*]DNP3
[*]Kibble42
[*]AudeoVisual[/list][/b]

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and may your marbles roll swiftly!
-Pixel by Pixel Studios

notes.title: The Zombie Apocalypse... I mean Season 19 is HERE!!!
notes.content:
[b]SEASON 19 is now LIVE today Wednesday September 30th, 2020!!![/b]

The update should be rolling out to steam as we speak!

If you are not seeing the update please try shutting down Steam and restarting it. It should process the update then!

The mobile app update for Android should also be rolling out soon on GooglePlay and the Apple iOS version should be available shortly.

Patch notes will be posted soon.

As always THANK YOU to this amazing Community! Without you and your support, we would not be here each and every season! Please always remember when you are out there racing and/or streaming to be respectful to all members of the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991916/4a0ded8545981335de20a4e2c3658a081d608a7d.png[/img]

---------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.

[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Crendentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in picked Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Royale or our newest mode Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get invovled in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season we take the top 10 Streamers and host a fun little collection of events and the streamer who earns the most points during the last day of the season events will earn their emote in the game for the next 2 seasons. Their emote will load their own custom marble into the race for that time.

[b]- Twitch Emotes?[/b]
Our game includes the functionality of certain emotes on Twitch.tv that will load specific skins into the game for the viewer who uses them. Its a fun little community thing we do.
Here is a list of Streamers that will have emotes in the game for Season 19:
[b][list][*]PixelbyPixelStudios
[*]Enderzworld
[*]Spooo
[*]StandardDamage
[*]LTDigilusion
[*]HeadsnapTV
[*]Sleepypan
[*]DNP3
[*]Kibble42[/list][/b]

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and may your marbles roll swiftly!
-Pixel by Pixel Studios

notes.title: Marble Fest Summer 2020
notes.content:

Each host will have 3 hours to run a Marbles on Stream Tournament as they wish, at the end of 3 hours each streamer will award the Top 3 some PbP Coins and the Top 25 from each streamer will win the Exclusive Marble Fest Summer 2020 marble. Once one streamer ends the next streamer begins! Below is a list of streamers and their time slots:

Below is a breakdown of who is streaming during Marble Fest 2020 and their times...

10am to 1pm ET - [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pixelbypixelstudios]PixelbyPixelStudios[/url]
1pm to 4pm ET - [url=https://www.twitch.tv/SportsCastSquad]SportsCastSquad[/url]

notes.title: SEASON 18 has ARRIVED!!!
notes.content:
[b]SEASON 18 is now LIVE today Wednesday August 5th, 2020!!![/b]

The Season 18 update should be rolling out to steam as we speak!

If you are not seeing the update please try shutting down Steam and restarting it. It should process the update then!

The mobile app update for Android should also be rolling out soon on GooglePlay and the Apple iOS version should be available shortly.

Patch notes will be posted soon.

Thank you as always to this amazing Community! We would not be here without ALL of you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991916/5498c81878c0e5ce2044a741088790eb2ce7fcf2.png[/img]


---------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.

[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Crendentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in picked Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Royale or our newest mode Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get invovled in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season we take the top 10 Streamers and host a fun little collection of events and the streamer who earns the most points during the last day of the season events will earn their emote in the game for the next 2 seasons. Their emote will load their own custom marble into the race for that time.

[b]- Emotes?[/b]
Our game includes the functionality of certain emotes on Twitch.tv that will load specific skins into the game for the viewer who uses them. Its a fun little community thing we do.
Whos emotes work in the game? 
Our channel emotes work PixelbyPixelStudios on Twitch, our community managers, Spooo and StandardDamage and the previous 2 season winners.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and much love to all!
Pixel by Pixel Studios team.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Season 17 - (3.0.4)
notes.content:

[b]General:[/b][list][*]New Maps: Taking Flight 2, On The Felt
[*]New Season 17 Skins, Modifiers, Effects, Pins, Player Card and Season Bundle
[*]New Season 17 Challenges
[*]Grand Prix Podium should now display the winners loadout if they have one setup (taken from the last race they participated in)
[*]Grand Prix Podium should now display the viewer's name color[/list]

[b]Track Builder:[/b][list][*]New Raffle Tumbler
[*]New Simple Shapes
[*]Max Track Pieces Season Pass changed from 300 to 310

[*]Max Uploads Non-Season Pass changed from 3 to 2[/list]

[b]Bugs Fixes:[/b][list][*]Fixed an issue where energy tiers were sometimes not rewarding energy

notes.title: SEASON 17 is now LIVE!!!
notes.content:
[b]SEASON 17 is now LIVE today Wednesday June 3rd, 2020!!![/b]

Marbles on Stream Season 17 is here! The update should be rolling out to steam as we speak!

If you are not seeing the update please try shutting down Steam and restarting it. It should process the update then!

The mobile app update for Android should also be rolling out now over GooglePlay and the Apple iOS version should be available shortly.

Patch notes will be posted soon.

Thank you as always to this amazing Community! We would not be here without ALL of you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991916/3a5852f8be619a508e03695b0a0fa9e9df792f77.png[/img]


[b]PLEASE NOTE THE RACER ENERGY TIER SYSTEM!!![/b]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/DfHYCwG/Point-system-s153.jpg[/img]

---------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.

[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Crendentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in picked Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Royale or our newest mode Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get invovled in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season we take the top 10 Streamers and host a fun little collection of events and the streamer who earns the most points during the last day of the season events will earn their emote in the game for the next 2 seasons. Their emote will load their own custom marble into the race for that time.

[b]- Emotes?[/b]
Our game includes the functionality of certain emotes on Twitch.tv that will load specific skins into the game for the viewer who uses them. Its a fun little community thing we do.
Whos emotes work in the game? 
Our channel emotes work PixelbyPixelStudios on Twitch, our community managers, Spooo and StandardDamage and the previous 2 season winners.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and much love to all!
Pixel by Pixel Studios team.

[b]Track Builder:[/b][list][*]Updated Various UVs for Map Builder Pieces

[*]Items in the shop should show their property images again
[*]Fixed an issue where you could get stuck in the settings menu in the Track Builder
[*]Fixed an issue where MyLoadout was not saving between races

notes.title: The Gates of Season 16 are now OPEN!
notes.content:
[b]Season 16 has launched TODAY April 1st, 2020[/b]

Marbles on Stream Season 16 is now live!!! !

If you are not seeing the update please try shutting down Steam and restarting it. It should process the update then! Patch Notes will be posted shortly! 

As always [b]Gratitude[/b] to this AMAZING Community! We would not be here without [b]ALL[/b] of you!
[img]https://i.ibb.co/2jRSdNp/S16-Cometh.png[/img]

[b]PLEASE NOTE THE RACER ENERGY TIER SYSTEM!!![/b]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/DfHYCwG/Point-system-s153.jpg[/img]

---------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.

[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Crendentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in picked Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Royale or our newest mode Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get invovled in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season we take the top 10 Streamers and host a fun little collection of events and the streamer who earns the most points during the last day of the season events will earn their emote in the game for the next 2 seasons. Their emote will load their own custom marble into the race for that time.

[b]- Emotes?[/b]
Our game includes the functionality of certain emotes on Twitch.tv that will load specific skins into the game for the viewer who uses them. Its a fun little community thing we do.
Whos emotes work in the game? 
Our channel emotes work PixelbyPixelStudios on Twitch, our community managers, Spooo and StandardDamage and the previous 2 season winners.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and much love to all!
Pixel by Pixel Studios team.

notes.title: Season 15 Mid-Season UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]Season 15 Mid-Season Update!!![/b]

Today (February 28th, 2020) we will be pushing a Mid Season update for Marbles on Stream.

[u][b]Included in this update[/b][/u]:[list][*] A total re-write of [u]Pixel's Procedural Pathway[/u].
[*] A new map builder piece.
[*] Some updated streamer marbles
[*] Skip Track button added for grand-prix races
[*] Add a notification when their is no active local leaderboard when viewing local results at the end of a race
[/list]
[b]Arcade Mode[/b][list][*] In this new Arcade Mode points do not count and you will not use any energy to enter in these races! Master the new !Boost system that will ONLY work in this new mode where again [u]you will not earn any points or XP[/u]. So have some fun with this new mode, capture some amazing clips and submit them to our discord.[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b][list][*] Fixed an issue where chat bubbles in the grand prix results UI were not showing
[*] Fixed an issue where player name color wasn't correctly showing in the grand prix results Chat History window
[*] Fixed an issue where the latest race winner was being populated by a simulation marble in the map selection UI[/list]

The big Season 16 Update is planned for Wednesday April 1st, 2020

Let us know what you think of this new Arcade and Boost Mode!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Season 15 - (2.0.3.0)
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes - Season 15 - (2.0.3.0)[/b]
[list][*] - New Maps: Love Is In The Air
[*] - New Season Skins and Modifiers have been added
[*] - New Season Challenges have been added
[*] - New: Marble Loadouts. Customize up to 5 loadouts in the customize menu[/list]
[b]Tilted:[/b][list][*]Difficulty now changes every 7 levels (was 8)
[*]Added an option for adding tilted results to the local leaderboard
[*]Added additional handling if an error occurs at the end of a race to attempt to finish the current level[/list]
[b]Streamer Season XP Changes:[/b][list][*] Bonuses races are now capped at 120[/list]
[b]Season Viewer Changes:[/b][list][*] Tier 4: Changed from 40 to 35 races
[*] Tier 5: Changed from 60 to 55 races
[*] Tier 6: Changed from 100 to 80
[*] Tier 7: 100 Races -> 30 Energy Returned
[*] Tier 8: 145 Races -> 35 Energy Returned
[*]New Chevron and Rank images have been added[/list]
[b]Shop:[/b][list][*] A new season bundle item has been added to the shop. These contain a bundle of items that are exclusive to the current season
[*] Items in the shop can now have rarities
[*] Hourly Shop now rotates every 3 hours
[*] Added UI to show if an item is loading
[*] Map Builder Pass starting coin cost has been reduced to 200 coins[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b][list][*]The top 200 positions are now displayed beside the Marble name during a race
[*]End of race results are now sortable by each respective column that contains a button
[*]Leaderboard layout in the main menu has been updated
[*]Clicking on the coins in the upper right hand of the menu now navigate to the coin section of the shop
[*]Added animations to areas in the main menu where voting occurs
[*]You can now reset local map records individually by clicking the 'X' button on the respective map
[*]Names in the energy earned list are now colored respectively to the players tag
[*]Updated marble royale pickup effects
[*]Extended the bounding volume for the marble sweeper
[*]Maps added to the grand prix should now display a check mark on the respective map in the list
[*]DNF ordering should now show from last eliminated to first eliminated[/list]
[b]Track Builder:[/b][list][*] 1 new start pieces
[*] 2 new middle pieces
[*] 1 new obstacles
[*] 4 new materials
[*] Fixed an undo/redo issue where moving a piece more than once would always 'undo' it's location back to where it was first spawned
[*] Fixed an issue where undo/redo events were being added to the list, even when nothing about the selected piece was modified[/list]
[b]Bugs Fixes:[/b][list][*] Fixed an issue where custom map data wasn't recording if a race wasn't finished
[*] Fixed an issue where clicking the Season Stats or Local Stats wasn't correctly updating the selected map UI that shows the track record information
[*] Added missing destructible meshes for marble royale
[*] Corrected incorrect font in energy earned list
[*] Numbers in the grand prix podium should now longer appear pixelated[/list]
[b]MOS Mobile Patch Notes![/b][list][*] New Spawn Effects: Rainbow Vortex, Spring Flowers
[*] New Trail Effects: Rainbow Glitter, Bowler Hat
[*] New Finish Effects: Crack Finisher, Vertical Hearts[/list]

notes.title: Marbles on Stream Season 15 has BEGUN!
notes.content:
[b]Season 15 has launched TODAY 29 Jan 2020[/b]

Marbles on Stream Season 15 is now live!!! !

If you are not seeing the update please try shutting down Steam and restarting it. It should process the update then! Patch Notes will be posted shortly! 

As always a huge thank you to this AMAZING Community! We would not be here without [b]ALL[/b] of you!
[img]https://i.ibb.co/YhC6wjR/Season-15-has-begun.jpg[/img]

[b]PLEASE NOTE THE NEW CHANGES TO THE RACER ENERGY TIER SYSTEM!!![/b]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/DfHYCwG/Point-system-s153.jpg[/img]

---------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.

[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Crendentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in picked Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Royale or our newest mode Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get invovled in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season we take the top 10 Streamers and host a fun little collection of events and the streamer who earns the most points during the last day of the season events will earn their emote in the game for the next 2 seasons. Their emote will load their own custom marble into the race for that time.

[b]- Emotes?[/b]
Our game includes the functionality of certain emotes on Twitch.tv that will load specific skins into the game for the viewer who uses them. Its a fun little community thing we do.
Whos emotes work in the game? 
Our channel emotes work PixelbyPixelStudios on Twitch, our community managers, Spooo and StandardDamage and the previous 2 season winners.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and much love to all!
Pixel by Pixel Studios team.

notes.title: End of Season 14 Tournament - January 26th 1pm to 4pm EST
notes.content:
The End of Season 14 is almost here! Season 14 will be Ending Sunday January 26th, 2020. The End of Season Tournament will be from 1-4pm EST. We have 5000 PbP Coins up for grabs plus many other prizes. This season we are doing things a bit different as your Community Managers [b]Spooo[/b] & [b]StandardDamage[/b] will be running the show along with their Co-Host [b]Nalutic[/b]! [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/pixelbypixelstudios]twitch.tv/PixelbyPixelStudios[/url],  [url=https://www.twitch.tv/standarddamage]twitch.tv/StandardDamage[/url], & [url=https://www.twitch.tv/nalutic]twitch.tv/Nalutic[/url][/b]

notes.title: Marbles on Stream Season 14 is LIVE
notes.content:
[b]Season 14 has launched TODAY 18 Dec 2019[/b]

Marbles on Stream Season 14 is now live!!! This update marks a few milestones for Marbles on Stream. We have completed our first full season on Steam and this will be the last major update of 2019 and the Decade! So go forth, enjoy the Holidays, and get those wins!

If you are not seeing the update please try shutting down Steam and restarting it. It should process the update then!

A huge thank you as always to this AMAZING Community! We would not be here without [b]ALL[/b] of you!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/tXV9zpv/season-14-has-begun.jpg[/img]

---------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.

[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Crendentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in picked Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Royale or our newest mode Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get invovled in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced seasons in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season we take the top 10 Streamers and host a fun little collection of events and the streamer who earns the most points during the last day of the season events will earn their emote in the game for the next 2 seasons. Their emote will load their own custom marble into the race for that time.

[b]- Emotes?[/b]
Our game includes the functionality of certain emotes on Twitch.tv that will load specific skins into the game for the viewer who uses them. Its a fun little community thing we do.
Whos emotes work in the game? 
Our channel emotes work PixelbyPixelStudios on Twitch, our community managers, Spooo and StandardDamage and the previous 2 season winners.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Marbles%20On%20Stream]Marbles on Stream[/url][/b] and people are playing Right now! We are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and much love to all!
Pixel by Pixel Studios team.

notes.title: Season 14 Energy and Points System Update
notes.content:
With the launch of Season 14 we are changing up the way the Racer Energy and Streamer Points systems work. Moving forward we are working to have the Marbles XP and Point system coincide along with the new changes Twitch has been making for viewers and streamers to have better alignment with our Marbles Racers and Streamers.

Below is a breakdown of how the new Season 14 system will work:

[b]Racer System[/b]
[list][*] Start each day 3am EST (12am PST) Racers will reset to  have 50 Energy.
[*] 1 Energy Spent per race participated in (Energy only spent on race completion)
[*] Earn Energy from completing bonus tiers in unique streams (meaning 5, 10, 20, etc in one individuals stream.)
    -Tier 1 = 5 total Races -> 5 Energy returned
    -Tier 2 = 10 total Races -> 6 Energy returned
    -Tier 3 = 20 total Races -> 12 Energy returned
    -Tier 4 = 40 total Races -> 20 Energy returned
    -Tier 5 = 60 total Races -> 20 Energy returned
    -Tier 6 = 100 total Races -> 40 Energy returned
[/list][i]0 Energy = 0 Season points distributed (Does effect Grand Prix, Does NOT effect local leaderboards)[/i][img]https://i.ibb.co/7V2kTf3/Point-system.png[/img]

[b]Streamer System[/b]
[list][*] 1 Bonus bonus races awarded per hour caps at 120
[*] Earn 2x XP for Bonus Races (1 Bonus race spent per race)
[*] Max Bonus XP for time in race 3 Mins (reduced from 6 Min)
[*] Earn Bonus XP for completing viewer tiers. Tier = XP rewarded
[/list][img]https://i.ibb.co/LnPtJjP/Point-system2.png[/img]
If you have any questions about this new system please post it below.

[b][i]If there are any updates to this system from now until actual launch this entry will be updated![/i][/b]

[b]NOTE:[/b] This implementation will only effect racers and streamers who play marbles at a global competitive level.

Season 14 is going to be unlike any other, it also marks the final update of 2019 and this decade!!!

notes.title: Welcome Everyone to the Marbles On Stream (MOS), Steam Community Hub!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome Everyone to the Marbles On Stream (MOS), Steam Community Hub[/b]

First of all we want to thank everyone for joining us for the first couple days so far of Season 13 of Marbles on Stream. New and returning users to Marbles, thank you for choosing to and continuing to share the experience of Marbles on Stream with your communities, we would not be here without you all. 

So we continue forward. As you may have noticed, we have already started posting events that are happening throughout the season. The events are:
[list]
[*] Community Day Every Single Friday [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/pixelbypixelstudios]Twitch.tv/PixelbyPixelStudios[/url][/b]. Race with the Marbles you want to win.
[*] Tournament Kits hosted by Streamers (Tues/Thurs/Fri/Sat) these are free to participate in and are high profile events for coins and exclusive effects
[*] Mid Season Tournament Hosted by Community Managers and Marbler of the Season Free Participation and Prizes available
[*] End of Season Tournament Hosted by Pixel by Pixel Studios and 2 hand Picked Streamers
[/list]

If you do not know what MoS is, it is a stream interactive game designed for streamers to involve their viewers in marble races. Our goals are always to produce high quality content for you all to enjoy with your communities. We also have a Community map builder where you can build and upload maps, or even Tilted Mode which gives the user control of the marbles that have joined to get as far as you can through procedurally generated tracks.

About the Studio:
We are a small dev team, new to the industry, excited to develop for a very active online community. 

One of our goals is to be easily accessible to everyone. If you want to interact with myself (Mike), the rest of the dev team or Marbles On Stream community, post your questions, concerns, or feedback here:
[list]
[*] Steam Community: Hub [url=steamcommunity.com/app/1170970]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1170970[/url]
[*] Discord: [url=Discord.gg/PixelbyPixelStudios]Discord.gg/PixelbyPixelStudios[/url]
[*] Twitch Streams: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pixelbypixelstudios]Twitch.tv/PixelbyPixelStudios[/url]
[/list]
Reach out, we are always happy to chat, whether it be to discuss the game, your streams, or even how we can better create content for you to share with your communities, we are always open to constructive conversations.

Thanks again from everyone here at 
Pixel by Pixel Studios.

notes.title: Marbles on Stream Season 13
notes.content:
[b]Marbles on Stream is Coming to Steam for Season 13[/b]

Season 13 has launched on 6 Nov 2019

As with some game releases there is always an issue or bug that appears with the launch. We are currently aware of a few bugs that are effecting downloading and logging into the Marbles on Stream client. These issues are currently being worked on as quickly as we can and hope to have a updated pushed live shortly. In the mean time if you are encountering any other bugs please post them in the discussions board here or reach out to us on our [url=https://discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios]DISCORD.gg/pixelbypixelstudios[/url]. Again we thank you for your understanding and your patience.


---------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.

[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Crendentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in picked Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Royale or our newest mode Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get invovled in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced season in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season we take the top 10 Streamers and host a fun little collection of events and the streamer who earns the most points during the last day of the season events will earn their emote in the game for the next 2 seasons. Their emote will load their own custom marble into the race for that time.

[b]- Emotes?[/b]
Our game includes the functionality of certain emotes on Twitch.tv that will load specific skins into the game for the viewer who uses them. Its a fun little community thing we do.
Whos emotes work in the game? 
Our channel emotes work PixelbyPixelStudios on Twitch, our community managers, Spooo and StandardDamage and the previous 2 season winners.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
The game is currently live and available on our Discord. If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category Marbles on Stream and people are playing Right now! We are so excited for this next chapter of Marbles on Stream and are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and much love to all!
Pixel by Pixel Studios team.

notes.title: Marbles on Stream Season 13
notes.content:
[b]Marbles on Stream is Coming to Steam for Season 13[/b]

Season 13 has a planned launch on 6 Nov 2019 at 12pm EST/ 9am PST

[b]- Now you may be wondering what is Marbles on Stream? [/b]
MoS is a stream interactive game designed to involve a Twitch Streamers viewers in a fun Marble racing game. All the viewer needs is to type !play in the respective streamers chat they would like to join. Simple and easy for all. 

[b]- Where were we before Steam?[/b]
We were tucked away in our little Discord server and that is how it was downloaded before as we developed out the game season by season. If you are interested in joining feel free as we use Discord as our gathering space for the community. Discord.gg/pixelbypixelstudios.

[b]- How to play Marbles on Stream?[/b]
Streamers - Download marbles, log in with your Twitch Crendentials so the game can connect to your Twitch chat and begin reading typed commands. Play in picked Game Tracks, Community Tracks, Marble Royale or our newest mode Tilted. All modes are viewer implemented so you can involve your viewers in all the game modes and just have fun.

Viewers/Racers - Join any stream on Twitch.tv streaming Marbles on Stream, be sure to greet the streamer, and get invovled in their races simply by typing !play in their chat.

[b]- Seasons?? Why?[/b]
We introduced season in May 2018 and each season brings new content to the game. It also resets the leaderboards and deletes all the community tracks from the global system. 

Leaderboard points are global which means it does not matter where you race, you are earning points towards your total. We also delete all the community tracks from our system so each season brings fresh tracks in, and gives the builders the chance to reflect on the votes and possibly make changes to their existing tracks. 

Streamers get a unique experience with Marbles. Streamers earn XP by conducting races. We use a very complex mathematical system to calculate how much each race earns them. At the end of the season we take the top 10 Streamers and host a fun little collection of events and the streamer who earns the most points during the last day of the season events will earn their emote in the game for the next 2 seasons. Their emote will load their own custom marble into the race for that time.

[b]- Emotes?[/b]
Our game includes the functionality of certain emotes on Twitch.tv that will load specific skins into the game for the viewer who uses them. Its a fun little community thing we do.
Whos emotes work in the game? 
Our channel emotes work PixelbyPixelStudios on Twitch, our community managers, Spooo and StandardDamage and the previous 2 season winners.

[b]Interested in getting involved now?[/b]
The game is currently live and available on our Discord. If you are simply looking to play the game as a racer, check out the Twitch category Marbles on Stream and people are playing Right now! We are so excited for this next chapter of Marbles on Stream and are always happy to engage with you all. Whether it be on our discord, here on the community hub or out there on the tracks, you will learn we are very passionate and love chatting with you all. 

Take care and much love to all!
Pixel by Pixel Studios team.
